scope: Operations: prepayments, card purchases and shared operation forms
Bookings: filters, tables and closure dialogs
Suppliers: search, invoice creation, invoice/payment detail dialogs
Invoices: filters, lists, services and invoice editing
Payments: filters, lists, inspector, creation and allocations
Accounting: entries, lines, accounts and rules
Setup: automation information, templates, permission filters and previews
findings_addressed: Two competing global palettes and repeated button/input/select declarations.
Section-specific font families, control heights, corners and focus states.
Hidden persistent filter labels and navigation items outside narrow viewports.
Duplicate arrow in payment account lookup.
Unsearchable long native select lists and inconsistent dropdown selection feedback.
Existing dropdowns clipped by scrolling ancestors.
Legacy ARIA dialogs without a shared focus containment/return mechanism.
Field errors not consistently associated with their input for assistive technology.

implementation.cascade: widget-tokens < widget-views < widget-controls; views retain composition and semantic status variants.
implementation.selects: Original select remains the value/validation source. Single-select popover emits input/change only when changed, checks stale option identity, supports optgroups and disabled options, and adds search above 10 options. Multiple selects retain native interaction. Popover-unsupported browsers retain native selects.
implementation.existing_menus: Existing filter and lookup nodes remain in their DOM location. Manual popovers avoid ancestor clipping without replacing business handlers.
implementation.dialogs: Native dialogs retain browser focus behavior. Legacy ARIA modal dialogs get containment and focus return; existing close/save/discard handlers keep ownership.

verification.browser: Local headless Microsoft Edge / Playwright, mocked CRM APIs; no live CRM writes.
verification.final_shared_ui_rerun: passed with live-rendered Prepayments and Card_Purchases editor fixtures, including locked financial fields
states: Long/short dropdown lists, selected/disabled options, no search results
Keyboard arrows, Enter, Escape, Tab, outside click
Legacy multiselect menu in a clipped container
Prepayment and card purchase editors at 1440 and 390 pixels; read-only financial fields
Modal focus containment, return and existing close refusal
Inline field error association and clearing
Few/many rows, progressive loading, errors, retries and empty states
Invoice edit background operation, recovery and duplicate prevention
Long references and service names, missing/zero amounts
Setup permission states, template previews and narrow layouts

unit_tests.failure_cause: All 11 fail reading missing historical Deluge files under _local/crm/crm_functions (ENOENT); no UI assertion failures.

limits: No live Zoho host/session verification or publication was performed.
Static form screenshots check layout, not server-populated financial values.
Not every possible CRM permission combination, record shape or report was opened.
Popover fallback on browsers without Popover API was retained but not exercised in an older browser.
This is a shared component consolidation, not a rewrite of every view-specific layout.
